2608.00651.title: Understanding Online Failure Prediction in Linux Through Complementary Multi-View Explainability
2608.00651.paper_summary: Accurate Online Failure Prediction (OFP) has been shown to be feasible in Operating Systems (OSs) settings, but prediction alone is not sufficient for practical adoption. Without diagnostic insight, operators have limited basis to trust alerts or decide how to respond. Moreover, even when predictive accuracy is high, it is often unclear whether models are capturing meaningful failure processes or merely exploiting workload-specific noise and incidental correlations in telemetry. This paper reports a practical experience building and evaluating an explainable OFP pipeline for Linux OSs. We combine consensus-based feature selection for detection with temporal onset analysis, subsystemlevel causal analysis, and complementary diagnostic mechanisms to support failure interpretation. Evaluated under strict crossworkload conditions with frozen training artifacts, it achieved 91-94% detection on unseen workloads without retraining, while maintaining false alarm rates below 1%. However, failure mode diagnosis proved substantially more sensitive to workload shift, and several diagnostics mechanisms showed limited effectiveness for specific failure types. Our experience highlights three main lessons: i) detection generalizes more robustly than diagnosis across workload changes; ii) early-warning capability depends strongly on the failure mode, ranging from 38 to 215 seconds in our study; and iii) unseen failure modes are not reliably diagnosable from related training modes alone, providing 0% accuracy under Leave-One-Mode-Out (LOMO) evaluation. Taken together, these results show the value of complementary explainability mechanisms for interpreting accurate failure predictions, revealing when predictive signals reflect transferable failure structure and when diagnostic generalization breaks down under workload variation.
2608.00651.paper_summary_zh: 準確的在線故障預測（OFP）已被證明在操作系統（OSs）環境中是可行的，但僅僅依賴預測並不足以實際採用。沒有診斷洞察，操作員對警報的信任基礎有限，或無法決定如何反應。此外，即使預測準確性很高，模型是否捕捉到有意義的故障過程，或僅僅是在利用工作負載特定的噪音和遙測中的偶然相關性，通常也不清楚。本文報告了一個為Linux操作系統構建和評估可解釋的OFP管道的實踐經驗。我們將基於共識的特徵選擇與時間發作分析、子系統層級因果分析和互補診斷機制相結合，以支持故障解釋。在嚴格的跨工作負載條件下，使用凍結的訓練工件進行評估，該管道在未見過的工作負載上達到了91-94%的檢測率，且無需重新訓練，同時保持虛報率低於1%。然而，故障模式診斷對工作負載變化的敏感性顯著更高，且幾個診斷機制對特定故障類型的有效性有限。我們的經驗突出了三個主要教訓：i）檢測在工作負載變化中比診斷更具穩健性；ii）早期警告能力強烈依賴於故障模式，在我們的研究中範圍從38秒到215秒；iii）僅從相關訓練模式中無法可靠地診斷未見的故障模式，在留一模式評估（LOMO）下提供了0%的準確率。綜合來看，這些結果顯示了互補解釋機制在解釋準確故障預測中的價值，揭示了何時預測信號反映可轉移的故障結構，以及何時診斷泛化在工作負載變化下失效。
